name: @gyral/mcp

tools.name: start_here
tools.description: Call this first, once per task. A short orientation for Gyral 0.3.5: the mental model, the rules agents most often break, the recommended workflow, which tool to use when, and an index from use case (form, fetch, search, routing, SSR, …) to the example and guide to start from. Gyral workflow: start_here once, then start from get_example or scaffold_component (working code); write the module right away; check_snippet it and apply the suggested fixes until it passes; get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Gyral 0.3.5 documentation (guides, API reference, examples) for one concept you need. Returns ranked sections with their URL; pass a URL to get_doc for the full text. Don't read the docs end to end before writing code. Gyral workflow: start_here once, then start from get_example or scaffold_component (working code); write the module right away; check_snippet it and apply the suggested fixes until it passes; get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "hydrate island" or "formAction 422".

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Returns one docs page as markdown, or one section when the reference has a #anchor (prefer a section: pages are long). Accepts a URL (https://gyral.dev/docs/forms/#the-server-half), a path (/docs/intent/) or a short name (intent, forms#the-server-half, api/core, examples). Gyral workflow: start_here once, then start from get_example or scaffold_component (working code); write the module right away; check_snippet it and apply the suggested fixes until it passes; get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error.

path_or_url.description: URL, path or page name, optionally with #anchor.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: For one name you already saw in an example, a scaffold or a compile error: its declaration, doc comment and import path, plus a usage module and the next call for a function, or a note for a type (TypeScript infers most Gyral types from define()). Not for learning the API or browsing types: scaffold_component and get_example give working code. A miss suggests the nearest export names. "*" lists the functions by task. Gyral workflow: start_here once, then start from get_example or scaffold_component (working code); write the module right away; check_snippet it and apply the suggested fixes until it passes; get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error.

symbol.description: Exported name, e.g. "define", or "*" for the index.

package.description: Limit to a package or entry point: "core", "@gyral/ssr/static".

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Every runnable example in the Gyral repo with what it demonstrates. Read the closest one with get_example and adapt it. Gyral workflow: start_here once, then start from get_example or scaffold_component (working code); write the module right away; check_snippet it and apply the suggested fixes until it passes; get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Workflow step 1: working code to start from. An example's description, link and the full source of its component files (start_here maps use cases to examples). Adapt it into a minimal implementation right away. Gyral workflow: start_here once, then start from get_example or scaffold_component (working code); write the module right away; check_snippet it and apply the suggested fixes until it passes; get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error.

tools.name: scaffold_component
tools.description: Workflow step 1: idiomatic starting code that imports only packages the project has installed (read from the project's package.json). "basic" (state, intents, pure update, view; a model test when @gyral/testing and vitest are installed), "form" (with valibot or zod 4 installed: a schema shared with the server; otherwise the dependency-free form), "form-native" (no dependencies: novalidate plus the browser's constraint checks, custom messages, focus on the first invalid field), "ssr-page" (light-DOM page, client entry, and a server route when @gyral/ssr is installed). Adapt it into a minimal implementation right away. Gyral workflow: start_here once, then start from get_example or scaffold_component (working code); write the module right away; check_snippet it and apply the suggested fixes until it passes; get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error.

tag.description: Custom element name with a hyphen, e.g. "todo-list".

description.description: What the component should do (added as a comment).

project_dir.description: The project whose package.json says what is installed (default: the server's project directory). Relative paths start there.

installed.description: Package names the project has installed, e.g. ["@gyral/core", "vitest", "@gyral/testing", "valibot"]. Added to what package.json says; without either, only @gyral/core is assumed.

tools.name: check_snippet
tools.description: Workflow step 3, after writing code: typechecks a TypeScript module against the project's installed TypeScript and @gyral/* types (the server's working directory, or GYRAL_PROJECT_DIR) and returns each error with a suggested fix, plus common Gyral mistakes TypeScript can't see (one-call define, listen in init, periodic, side effects in update, handlers in views, rows without a TemplateResult return type). Apply the fixes and call it again until it passes. Use it before presenting Gyral code. Gyral workflow: start_here once, then start from get_example or scaffold_component (working code); write the module right away; check_snippet it and apply the suggested fixes until it passes; get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error.

code.description: A complete TypeScript module, imports included.

instructions: Gyral workflow: 1. start_here once, or go straight to scaffold_component (basic, form-native, form, ssr-page) or get_example for working code. 2. Write the module right away. 3. Run check_snippet on every file, apply its suggested fixes and check again until it passes before answering. Call get_api only for a name you already saw in an example or an error: TypeScript infers Gyral's types from define(), so don't look them up one by one. Gyral components are Model-View-Intent custom elements with their own view layer (html, css, each from @gyral/core): intent parses DOM events into typed messages, update is one pure reducer per message, view names intents with data-intent (no event handlers), and side effects are commands. A component in its own module must be imported by the entry module (import './my-widget.js'), or its tag is never defined. The rules and decision tables: the gyral://skill resource.
